name: get_cubic_src
command:
import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
import json,pathlib,subprocess,sys,re
lane=pathlib.Path('.').resolve()
plan=dict(url='https://arxiv.org/pdf/1012.2878',routes=['318163','320844'],destination='sources/cubic-pm-1012.2878.pdf',source_identity='Esperet, Kardos, King, Kral and Norine, Exponentially many perfect matchings in cubic graphs, arXiv 1012.2878',purpose='Confirm the public cubic theorem for target 318163 and read the regular-graph conjecture for target 320844')
w=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',str(lane/'write_lane.py'),'plans/get-cubic.json'],input=json.dumps(plan,indent=1)+'\n',text=True,capture_output=True)
print('writer',w.returncode,w.stderr)
r=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',str(lane/'source_get_guard.py'),'plans/get-cubic.json'],capture_output=True,text=True,cwd=str(lane))
print('guard exit',r.returncode); print(r.stdout[-400:]); print(r.stderr[-400:])
if r.returncode: sys.exit(r.returncode)
t=subprocess.run(['pdftotext','-layout','sources/cubic-pm-1012.2878.pdf','-'],capture_output=True).stdout.decode('utf8','replace')
w=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',str(lane/'write_lane.py'),'text/cubic-pm.txt'],input=t,text=True,capture_output=True)
print('text writer',w.returncode,len(t))
t2=re.sub(r' {2,}',' ',t)
print(t2[:2200])
for m in re.finditer(r'(?i)conjecture|theorem 1\b',t2):
    print('---',m.start(),t2[max(0,m.start()-120):m.start()+260].replace('\n',' '))
